components.role_description: number of vertices in the tree
parent indices for vertices 2 to n defining the rooted tree
known or erased path sums from vertices to root, with -1 for erased

constraints.name: nonnegative_vertex_values
constraints.description: 每个顶点的原始值 a_v 是非负整数。

constraints.name: path_sum_definition
constraints.description: 对于每个顶点 v,s_v 定义为从 v 到根路径上所有 a_u 之和,且 s_1 = a_1。
constraints.formal: s_v = sum_{u in path(v to root)} a_u, s_1 = a_1

constraints.name: fixed_s_for_odd_depth
constraints.description: 深度为奇数的顶点 v 的 s_v 值已在输入中给出（不为 -1）,这些值必须在解中保持不变。
constraints.formal: For all v with odd h_v, s_v = given_s[v] (given_s[v] != -1)

constraints.name: minimize_total_sum_of_a
constraints.description: 若存在合法的恢复方案,要求找到使所有 a_v 总和最小化的方案,并输出该最小总和；如果没有任何合法方案,输出 -1。
constraints.formal: minimize sum_{v} a_v; output -1 if infeasible

objective.description: minimize total sum of vertex values a_v

invariants.name: monotonicity_of_known_sums_on_odd_levels
invariants.description: Known path sums on odd depths must satisfy non-decreasing order along any root-to-leaf path because the original values are non-negative.

invariants.name: resolve_unknown_s_by_min_child
invariants.description: An unknown path sum at an even depth is replaced by the minimum known path sum among its children (odd depth) or zero if no children exist, which minimizes the total sum of node values under non-negativity and monotonicity constraints.

properties.rule: unknown_s = min(children_known_s) if children exist else 0

original_problem.title: A
original_problem.description:
Mitya has a rooted tree with $n$ vertices indexed from $1$ to $n$, where the root has index $1$. Each vertex $v$ initially had an integer number $a_v \ge 0$ written on it. For every vertex $v$ Mitya has computed $s_v$: the sum of all values written on the vertices on the path from vertex $v$ to the root, as well as $h_v$ — the depth of vertex $v$, which denotes the number of vertices on the path from vertex $v$ to the root. Clearly, $s_1=a_1$ and $h_1=1$.

Then Mitya erased all numbers $a_v$, and by accident he also erased all values $s_v$ for vertices with even depth (vertices with even $h_v$). Your task is to restore the values $a_v$ for every vertex, or determine that Mitya made a mistake. In case there are multiple ways to restore the values, you're required to find one which minimizes the total sum of values $a_v$ for all vertices in the tree.


-----Input-----

The first line contains one integer $n$ — the number of vertices in the tree ($2 \le n \le 10^5$). The following line contains integers $p_2$, $p_3$, ... $p_n$, where $p_i$ stands for the parent of vertex with index $i$ in the tree ($1 \le p_i < i$). The last line contains integer values $s_1$, $s_2$, ..., $s_n$ ($-1 \le s_v \le 10^9$), where erased values are replaced by $-1$.


-----Output-----

Output one integer — the minimum total sum of all values $a_v$ in the original tree, or $-1$ if such tree does not exist.


-----Examples-----
Input
5
1 1 1 1
1 -1 -1 -1 -1

Output
1

Input
5
1 2 3 1
1 -1 2 -1 -1

Output
2

Input
3
1 2
2 -1 1

Output
-1
